name: agent-builder-prompt
body:
The distributed `agent-builder` agent template `opencode-suite/agents/agent-builder.md` (product source embedded via `include_str!` in `rust.apg.install`'s `AGENTS` table and installed by `apg init` into `~/.config/opencode/agents/`). Surfaces it carries:
(a) its own `permissions` array carries `shell`-action rules granting `git add *`/`git commit *` alongside the read-only git patterns, which are EXACT (`git status *`, `git log *`, `git branch --show-current`, `git remote -v`, `git remote show *`, `git ls-files *`) and stand apart from the blanket `git branch *`/`git remote *` — their option/subcommand surface admits ref-writing (`git branch -f`/`-D`/`-m`) and config-mutating (`git remote add`/`remove`/`set-url`) forms outside the agent-builder's remit; rule 2 permits add+commit (push/tag human-approved), it states that `--output=<file>` is FORBIDDEN on every granted git verb (`git log *`, the one granted verb that admits it, logs to stdout only; the glob admits that form, which is recorded as an accepted risk), and the body states it scaffolds/updates `.opencode/agents/**` AND creates/updates the repo's `opencode.json` agent→model map AND maintains the repo-root `AGENTS.md` on the main checkout and commits there;
(b) the push/tag policy: the ONLY generated agent granted push/tag is the optional `release-agent` (as `ask`);
(c) worktree-write-scope (`requirements.requirement.code-writer-worktree-only-writes`): the "Worktree mirroring (MANDATORY)" bullet and rule 10 are ROLE-AWARE — generated CODE-WRITERS (implementer, `*-implementer`, `test-implementer`) are granted write globs ONLY under `apg/.worktrees/*/`, with root paths excluded and each code-writer's deny rules worktree-rooted alongside its allows; the agent-builder holds main-checkout `edit` rules for `.opencode/agents/**` AND `opencode.json` AND the repo-root `AGENTS.md` (all resolved against the session workspace root, mirrored nowhere under `apg/.worktrees/*/` and broadened nowhere beyond those paths); the `release-agent` holds main-checkout release-artefact grants with no worktree mirror, its set derived by the agent-builder's per-repo analysis and confirmed in the coordinator interview (a per-repo set).
(d) the `opencode.json` agent→model map (`requirements.requirement.agent-builder-model-map`): the template instructs the agent-builder to create/update the main-checkout `opencode.json`, interviewing the coordinator/user for `agents.<name>.model` preferences over the agents it scaffolds AND the distributed suite agents and recording the chosen values; the write MERGES — only the interviewed `agents.<name>.model` entries change, and unrelated config keys and unmentioned existing entries survive; `codebase-navigator` is deliberately EXCLUDED from the map (the map omits any `agents.codebase-navigator.model` entry).
(e) the `AGENTS.md` hygiene responsibility (`requirements.requirement.agent-builder-agents-md-hygiene`): the template instructs the agent-builder to keep each repo's `AGENTS.md` consistent with the distributed-agent rules and clear of the canonical staged flow (owned solely and immutably by `codebase-navigator`, `requirements.requirement.navigator-staged-flow`) — it audits the guide and removes any flow content, adds nothing about the navigator and restates the flow nowhere — NON-DESTRUCTIVELY (every repo-specific section preserved), only where an `AGENTS.md` exists (manufactured nowhere), and universally across apg projects.

Deliberately a NARROW owner, distinct from `solution.component.navigator-prompt-guidance` (both prompt files, realised-by `domain.entity.graph-first-navigation`) and from `solution.component.agent-fs-permission-grants` (this same file, the fs-tool grant rules): `rust.apg.plan_cmd.verify.coverage_check` then maps coverage 1:1 to the edited file. The `AGENTS.md` hygiene concern has its own even-narrower owner, `solution.component.agent-builder-agents-md-hygiene` (same singleton `implemented-by` target). Product source in `solution.container.opencode-suite`; the repo's own `.opencode/agents/**` are consumer artifacts.

implemented-by: `opencode-suite/agents/agent-builder.md`.
